title: Perfect risotto
instructions: Bring the stock to the boil in a pan and keep it hot. Taste it: stock cubes are often too salty, so water it down if needed. Finely chop the onion, dice the 50g butter and grate the cheese.
Melt the 25g butter in a heavy straight-sided pan and soften the onion. Add the rice, turn up the heat and stir to coat the grains.

When the rice is hot, add the wine and stir until it has evaporated. Add the stock a ladleful at a time, stirring until nearly absorbed before the next; the rice should stay sloppy, never dry. Add any extra ingredients about 10 minutes in.
After about 13 minutes the rice begins to soften: add the stock in smaller amounts and test often until it is cooked to your liking.
Beat in the diced butter and grated cheese with gusto until rich and creamy. Check the seasoning and serve at once.
